jobs.title: Product Manager, Onboarding
jobs.description:
About the Role:

The Product Manager, Systems plays a critical role in ensuring the product organization builds the right solutions in the right way by deeply understanding how the system operates today, how clients and associates use it, and what investments are needed to improve performance, stability, quality and ultimately scalability over time. This role includes writing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria, and leading cross-functional refinement sessions.  
  
This role sits at the intersection of client needs, business priorities, technology capabilities, and cross-team execution. As a PM, you will be making informed trade-offs on how to maximize the velocity of the team, the sequencing of the work optimally, balancing effectively, instrument outcomes, and creating the flexibility needed for rapid experimentation. By maintaining a clear view of system health, dependencies, risks, and future opportunities, the Product Manager, Systems enables stronger product decisions, faster learning, more reliable delivery, and ultimately better end-to-end experiences.

**Day to day, you’ll…**
-----------------------

* Execute delivery of a defined roadmap for Onboarding initiatives that will enable assisted tax clients to easily provide their data and documents to H&R Block and have a successful tax engagement with their tax professional
* Ensure the successful execution and delivery of assigned features within large-scale products, organizing necessary resources through planning ceremonies, and supporting the product backlog while managing scope, schedule, quality, costs, resources and risks
* Write detailed user stories and requirements with acceptance criteria that can be properly translated into automated tests
* Lead product ceremonies for cross-functional product squads using modern SDLC best practices and methodologies, ensuring high performance and collaboration. Create an environment of psychological safety for innovation and foster a strong sense of ownership within the team
* Coordinate activities and report regularly to the product team and leadership; regularly conduct team retrospectives and drive resulting actions
* Utilize tools such as WalkMe, LaunchDarkly or Adobe Target to conduct tests and experiments. Use data to continuously evaluate and adapt strategies based on test results, focusing on delivering measurable outcomes
* Accountable for ensuring the quality of features delivered by the trio and achieving defined OKRs (Outcomes and Key Results)
* Foster strong collaboration with engineering, design, and business teams to ensure alignment and integration
* Engage in personal development to enhance product management competencies and adjacent functions such as Agile, Lean, DevOps, etc.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or related area, or the equivalent through a combination of education and work experience.
* 3 years of experience in product management or a related role
* Familiarity with formal product management methodologies
* Basic technical understanding to be able to engage with engineering teams and familiarity with technology delivery/software development methodologies (notably Agile, Lean, DevOps).
* Demonstrated decision making, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective in leading teams/squads in a matrix management environment with demonstrated record of establishing priorities and deadlines.
* Effective oral, written and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate with all levels of internal associates, external vendors and business partners.
* Ability to work effectively as a part of a team with minimal formal supervision or guidance.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Tax or financial industry background
* Familiarity in building mobile apps
* Formal product management certifications or training, or equivalent
* Expertise with product planning tools (ADO, TheyDo, Atlassian)

Why work for us: At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.
  
  
That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work. Pay Range Information: The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit. Pay Range: $81,600.00 - $122,400.00/Yr. Sponsored Job: #LI-CS1 #LI-REMOTE

Description:

**Position Summary**

The Implementation Specialist supports onboarding, implementation, and adoption of TRIARQ Health solutions. Partnering with Client Onboarding leadership, this role coordinates activities, advances client readiness, delivers training, and supports implementations through GoLive.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who anticipates needs, resolves issues, and follows through with precision. This role independently owns assigned workstreams within the implementation strategy set by Client Onboarding leadership. EMR, revenue cycle workflow, and training experience are required.

*What Success Looks Like*

* Owns workstreams and delivers with minimal supervision.
* Anticipates needs and proactively supports implementation and training.
* Builds strong client and cross-functional partnerships.
* Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Delivers training that drives confidence and adoption.
* Manages concurrent implementations with precision and adaptability.

*Key Responsibilities*

Implementation Support & Client Onboarding

* Support onboarding and implementation from discovery through GoLive.
* Execute implementation plans and milestones with leadership.
* Lead discovery of workflows, requirements, and objectives.
* Coordinate Product, Support, IT, Client Success, and Revenue Cycle teams.
* Maintain project records and escalate risks, blockers, and concerns.
* Support departmental initiatives and special projects.
* Support system setup, workflow mapping, configuration, and validation.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and GoLive readiness.
* Troubleshoot issues and coordinate internal resolution.
* Develop knowledge of HL7, APIs, sFTP, webhooks, and related technologies.

Client Training & Enablement

* Create and maintain guides and onboarding resources.
* Apply adult-learning principles to strengthen knowledge transfer and adoption.
* Evaluate effectiveness and provide post-GoLive reinforcement

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
* 2-4 years in healthcare technology, onboarding, implementation, training, or support.
* Experience with EMR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, or related technology.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to build relationships and manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Camtasia, Articulate, Adobe Captive or similar tools.

jobs.title: Commercial Onboarding and Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW OF THE POSITION**  
The Onboarding and Payroll Specialist is responsible for executing the end to end onboarding and payroll processes with accuracy, compliance, and exceptional service. This role ensures all candidate documentation, background checks, timekeeping processes, payroll submissions, and client specific requirements are completed according to company standards.

Success in this role requires comfort working with AI powered onboarding tools, automated verification systems, digital payroll workflows, and synthetic/AI teammates to enhance accuracy, reduce manual workload, and accelerate processing timelines. The Specialist collaborates closely with recruiters, compliance teams, and internal operations to create seamless experience for candidates and clients across multiple programs.

**DESCRIPTION OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS** ***(for each duty and function listed indicates % of time to total 100%)*****:**

* Facilitate and manage the complete onboarding process in alignment with state, federal, and client-specific requirements.
* Collect, validate, and process all onboarding documents, leveraging AI-driven document verification tools and digital workflows.
* Initiate, monitor, and adjudicate background checks using automated screening platforms; ensure all results meet contractual and regulatory standards.
* Educate candidates on timekeeping procedures, payroll timelines, and required platforms (including VMS systems when applicable).
* Manage the weekly payroll process, including timecard collection, validation, troubleshooting, and processing through automated systems.
* Partner with candidates, clients, and recruiters to ensure timely approval and submission of timecards.
* Utilize auditing tools to verify timecard accuracy and identify discrepancies before payroll submission.
* Organize and maintain payroll documentation in compliance with ESO standards and audit readiness guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve onboarding or payroll issues efficiently, escalating complex issues when appropriate.
* Support customers and associate expectations with professionalism, empathy, and effective communication.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and timelines in a fast paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Maintain accurate records and performance metrics through digital tracking and analytics dashboards.
* Support special projects and continuous improvement initiatives involving automation, process optimization, and compliance enhancements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum 2 years of HR, onboarding, payroll, or staffing industry experience.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with both human teams and AI/synthetic contributors.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to solve problems and adapt quickly in a demanding environment.
* Basic accounting and payroll knowledge preferred.
* Comfort making recommendations based on data findings and system insights.

**SUPERVISION EXERCISED/ #OF STAFF:**  
None

**LANGUAGE/COMMUNICATION SKILLS** ***(written & verbal)***:

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with candidates, clients, and internal teams.
* Strong discretion and confidentiality when managing sensitive data.

**COMPUTER/SYSTEM SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel (formulas, pivot tables, reconciliation).
* Experience with electronic onboarding systems, VMS tools, or HRIS platforms preferred.
* Comfort using AI-enabled onboarding tools, automated verification systems, and payroll technology.
* Ability to learn new platforms and digital workflows quickly.

jobs.title: Sr. Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Sr Implementation Specialist serves as an experienced implementation professional responsible for leading complex software configuration, testing, and customer onboarding activities across Alkami Digital Banking implementations. This role independently manages implementation execution for diverse customer environments, including onboarding and live-client work, coordinates cross-functional delivery efforts, and guides customers through configuration, testing, cutover readiness, and launch activities to ensure successful implementation outcomes and positive customer experiences. The position applies advanced product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, and project coordination skills to resolve implementation challenges, support operational readiness, and improve implementation quality and efficiency. The Sr Implementation Specialist operates independently on complex engagements, contributes to process improvements, and provides functional leadership within assigned product or implementation ownership areas.

**Essential Duties &** **Responsibilities**

* Lead complex software implementation activities by configuring and customizing Alkami products to support customer onboarding, testing, training, and launch readiness requirements across diverse implementation environments
* Independently manage customer implementation engagements by coordinating configuration tasks, ticket-driven workflows, project milestones, and stakeholder alignment across customers, vendors, and internal teams throughout project execution
* Guide customers through user acceptance testing and operational readiness activities by facilitating testing sessions, validating workflows, troubleshooting issues, and supporting implementation and cutover readiness requirements
* Perform advanced functional and integration testing by analyzing system behaviors, validating configurations, documenting results, and resolving implementation-related discrepancies prior to deployment
* Troubleshoot complex configuration, usability, and implementation issues by performing root-cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and coordinating resolution efforts across technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders
* Collaborate with customers and third-party vendors by gathering configuration requirements, validating implementation details, and ensuring external dependencies are aligned with project timelines and delivery objectives
* Provide regular implementation updates to customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders by communicating project progress, issue resolution status, testing outcomes, and operational risks throughout implementation engagements
* Track and manage implementation activities by maintaining visibility into configuration progress, testing milestones, issue escalations, and project dependencies across multiple concurrent implementations
* Develop and maintain detailed implementation documentation by recording configuration settings, testing outcomes, issue logs, standard operating guidance, and customer and vendor communications throughout the implementation lifecycle
* Support implementation-related billing coordination by accurately documenting add-on sales activities, validating billable work, and ensuring implementation-related charges are properly tracked and communicated
* Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned Alkami products, integrations, or implementation functions by maintaining advanced knowledge, guiding delivery decisions, and supporting consistent execution across customer engagements
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, and Implementation teams by communicating customer feedback, implementation trends, and operational challenges that influence process improvements and product enhancements
* Manage multiple complex implementation priorities simultaneously by balancing customer needs, testing activities, issue resolution efforts, and project timelines across concurrent engagements
* Contribute to operational improvement initiatives by identifying implementation inefficiencies, recommending workflow enhancements, improving documentation and testing practices, and supporting best-practice development that improves implementation scalability and customer experience
* Support and mentor less experienced implementation specialists by providing guidance on testing methodologies, troubleshooting practices, customer and vendor communication strategies, and implementation procedures

**Recommended Experience & Education**

***Minimum Years of Experience***

3–6 years of experience leading software implementations, customer onboarding activities, configuration management, testing operations, or technical consulting engagements within SaaS, fintech, banking technology, or related environments.

***Education Level*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications**

**Required**

* Advanced experience supporting software implementations, configuration management, and customer onboarding activities
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills related to software configuration, testing, vendor coordination, and implementation issues across multiple customer environments
* Ability to independently manage complex implementation projects and competing priorities
* Experience facilitating user acceptance testing, functional validation, and operational readiness activities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer-facing and cross-functional stakeholder experience
* Experience collaborating with customers, vendors, and technical teams to coordinate implementation execution
* Ability to maintain detailed implementation documentation and operational tracking materials
* Strong organizational, analytical, and customer relationship management skills in fast-paced implementation environments

New Logo

* Ability to travel up to 20% to support implementation projects

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting fintech, SaaS, or digital banking implementation programs
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or technical onboarding concepts
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar project management, testing, issue tracking, and documentation platforms
* Experience contributing to process optimization or implementation scalability initiatives
* Knowledge of software deployment, operational readiness, or change management practices
* Experience mentoring implementation specialists or supporting team knowledge-sharing activities

  
The salary range for this position is: $78,540 - $98,175

jobs.title: SVP - Implementation - Corporate Travel Management
jobs.description:
**Summary**
===========

Direct Travel is seeking a strategic, results-driven executive to serve as Senior Vice President of Implementation. This leader owns the full customer activation lifecycle across our global footprint and is accountable for delivering fast, high-quality, repeatable onboarding that speeds up time to revenue and sets clients up for long-term success.

The SVP leads two organizations, Implementation and Global Solution Design. They set the vision, operating model, and performance standards for how Direct Travel scopes, sells, and delivers global travel programs. As a member of the extended leadership team, the SVP works with Sales, Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, and Legal to turn commercial wins into operational success, and drives company-wide initiatives that align systems, processes, and people for growth at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Strategic Leadership & Organizational Ownership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Set and carry out the multi-year strategy for implementation and global solution design, in line with company growth, retention, and profitability goals.
* Own the organization's budget, headcount plan, and resource model. Scale capacity ahead of pipeline and sales forecasts.
* Design the organization, roles, and career paths needed to support a growing, increasingly global client base.
* Represent Implementation at the executive level: report on performance, risks, and investment needs to the Chief Customer Success Officer and leadership team.

**Implementation Delivery & Operational Excellence**
----------------------------------------------------

* Hold executive accountability for every client implementation, from contract signature through go-live, phase-ins, acquisitions, and global expansions.
* Build and continuously improve a scalable, standardized implementation methodology and playbook, with clear stage gates, governance, and quality controls.
* Use automation, tooling, and data to cut cycle times, lower cost-to-implement, and improve predictability.
* Set up portfolio-level governance that gives the organization visibility into delivery health, at-risk accounts, and backlog.
* Serve as the final escalation point for high-risk or strategic implementations. Resolve issues quickly and protect client relationships and revenue.

**Global Solution Design & Commercial Partnership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the Global Solution Design function, making sure multinational client solutions are commercially sound, operationally deliverable, and matched to local and regional service capabilities.
* Partner with Sales leadership on strategic pursuits and RFPs. Provide executive-level solutioning, implementation strategy, and client-facing presence in final-stage presentations.
* Make sure every solution sold can be delivered. Hold scoping, pricing assumptions, and contract commitments to standard, and flag delivery risk early in the sales cycle.
* Work with Product and Technology to shape the service and platform roadmap based on client requirements and market trends.

**Client Executive Engagement**
-------------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with client executives (travel, procurement, finance, and HR leaders), acting as a strategic advisor through onboarding and into steady state.
* Deliver a smooth transition to Account Management and Operations, with clear success criteria and post-implementation reviews.
* Use client feedback and implementation data to raise satisfaction and support long-term retention and growth.

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing global team of implementation directors, project managers, solution designers, and technical specialists.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and client focus.
* Set clear goals and performance expectations. Develop the next generation of leaders and plan for succession.

**Key Performance Outcomes**
----------------------------

* Faster time to revenue by shortening implementation cycle times.
* New air booking transaction targets met through strong onboarding and service adoption.
* Implementations delivered on time, on scope, and within budget.
* High client satisfaction and adoption at go-live, and fewer revenue-at-risk accounts.
* Better implementation margin and efficiency as the business scales.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in travel management, professional services, implementation, or customer success, including at least 5 years at the senior executive level leading multi-team, global organizations.
* A proven record of building and scaling implementation functions, including methodology, tooling, metrics, and org design, in a high-growth or transforming business.
* Deep expertise in global service delivery and solution design for complex multinational clients.
* Strong commercial sense and experience working with Sales on strategic deals and complex RFPs.
* In-depth knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems and technology platforms (such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Spotnana), as well as online booking tools and industry best practices.
* Experience managing budgets, headcount, and operating KPIs, and making data-driven decisions.
* Executive presence and strong communication skills, with the ability to influence the C-suite both internally and at clients.
* A track record of leading distributed, virtual, and global teams.
* A bachelor's degree is highly preferred; an MBA or PMP is a plus.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology-led service with a human touch.

### **About the Role**

The Training Specialist supports the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of enablement programs for Customer Success — primarily onboarding and skills training for Marketing Assistants and Account Managers. Working within established frameworks and with guidance from senior team members, delivers training on the Scorpion technology suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal), client communication and service standards, and core digital marketing concepts to help client-facing teams ramp quickly and consistently.

### **What Your Success Will Look Like**

* Deliver established onboarding and skills-training programs for customer-facing roles (client communication, service standards, tools, turnaround expectations).
* Facilitate sessions in person and virtually, applying proven techniques with coaching from senior team members.
* Build and maintain training content and job aids on the Scorpion tech suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal) and digital-marketing channels (SEO, paid, social, content).
* Administer learning paths in the LMS / enablement platform (scheduling, enrollment, completion tracking).
* Gather and summarize feedback, assessment results, quality scores, and completion data to support refinement.
* Contribute to the enablement content library and suggest improvements to existing materials.
* Partner with AMs, Directors, leadership, and support teams to keep content current with evolving tools and client processes.
* Build foundational knowledge of account management and customer success best practices.

* Education
  + Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or related field —or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience
  + 2+ years of experience in Enablement, Training, Account Management, Customer Success, or Learning & Development — preferably in digital marketing / SaaS; or advanced degree; or equivalent.
  + Working proficiency with LMS, Zoom, Google Workspace, MS Office 365; familiarity with CRM / CS tooling a plus.
  + Familiarity with digital-marketing channels (SEO, paid, social, content) and client-service workflows.

* Skills
  + Solid facilitation and presentation skills.
  + Strong written/verbal communication and organizational skills; collaborative and proactive.

### **Our Scorpion Values**

* **Winning Mindset:** When our clients win, we win.

* **Unbeatable Teamwork:** We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
* The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

### **Our Benefits**

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

* 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work

For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Implementation Manager (West)
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

#### **What You Will Be Doing:**

You will join Beacon's Clinical Implementation team, reporting to the National Clinical Implementation Director. This is a remote, US-based individual contributor role anchored in our West territory, with travel to customer sites across your assigned region. The role does not carry direct reports, but you will mentor peers and newer specialists and may direct the work of others on implementation projects.

You will own the clinical and operational implementation of Beacon's diagnostic solutions for assigned customers, guiding sleep labs, health systems, and provider organizations from contract pre-signature through confident, sustained daily use of our products. Day to day, that means delivering demos, building implementation plans, running clinical education and training, supporting go-lives, and coaching accounts through adoption after launch.  

This is not a traditional implementation role focused only on deployment and go-live milestones. Your impact is measured by sustained usage, behavioral adoption, and long-term workflow integration. At this level, your influence extends beyond your own accounts: you set the standards, playbooks, and best practices the broader team works from, and you help shape where the clinical implementation function goes over the next several quarters.

The role is highly cross-functional and requires strong communication, systems thinking, empathy, and execution discipline. You will work across clinicians, executives, and frontline staff while maintaining clarity, momentum, and trust throughout the customer journey.  

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, or the Bay Area.

#### **What Success Looks Like:**

* You own end-to-end implementation execution for your accounts such as kickoff, project planning, milestone tracking, risk identification, and stabilization, and the accounts transition cleanly into steady-state support with decisions and configurations documented.
* You provide virtual and on-site clinical support across every phase of implementation, from pre-planning and education through go-live and post-launch troubleshooting.
* You build implementation plans that account for clinical workflow design, staffing models, order and result routing, patient communication, and administrative processes, and you coordinate resources across Customer Success, Clinical, Technical Services, Support, and Product to keep them on schedule.
* You deliver comprehensive training and demos tailored to each audience (physicians, advanced practice providers, sleep technologists, medical assistants, schedulers, and administrative staff) and maintain the reusable materials, quick-reference guides, and competency checklists that make training repeatable.
* You own adoption outcomes, tracking utilization, ordering patterns, turnaround, and workflow adherence against agreed targets, and delivering refresher training as turnover, new hires, and product changes require.
* You diagnose the root cause of low or inconsistent usage (workflow friction, training gaps, staffing constraints, process breakdown) in situations where the data alone does not give you the answer, and you drive corrective action.
* You partner with clinical and operational leaders to redesign workflows so Beacon is embedded in daily practice, and you connect usage data back to the customer's stated clinical and operational goals.
* You serve as the clinical operational point of contact through pre-sale, implementation, and early adoption, building trusted relationships from frontline staff to the executive level and communicating status, risks, and decisions proactively.
* You act as the clinical subject matter expert on sleep testing workflows and home sleep apnea testing, ensuring clinical messaging and training content align with product capabilities, supporting evidence, and regulatory requirements.
* You exercise independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including how implementations are sequenced, how adoption is measured, and what counts as a stabilized account, and you determine your own approach on first-of-kind customers, new indications, and accounts with no precedent.
* You partner with Regional Sales Managers on clean handoffs, participate in QBRs and renewal or expansion discussions, and surface adoption risks, churn signals, and expansion opportunities early with supporting evidence.
* You give Product structured feedback grounded in real implementation experience, identify recurring friction points, propose scalable solutions, and support go-to-market readiness for new features and indications.
* You mentor and coach peers and newer specialists on strategy, execution, customer judgment, and collaboration, including areas outside their functional skillset, and you build the templates and playbooks that raise the team's standard.
* You prioritize and plan multi-quarter priorities for the clinical implementation function, represent it in cross-team planning with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, and make decisions based on the needs of multiple stakeholder teams and the company as a whole.
* You initiate improvement projects independently, arriving with a defensible approach rather than waiting for direction, where recurring gaps in process, tooling, or enablement limit team outcomes.
* You adhere to all regulatory, compliance, quality, and privacy standards applicable to medical devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), including HIPAA, and support audits, documentation, and quality processes as required.

#### **Must-Haves:**

* Active RPSGT certification
* 8+ years of direct experience in sleep medicine, sleep lab operations, or home sleep apnea testing
* Demonstrated experience owning demos, customer implementations, clinical training, or go-live support in healthcare settings
* Experience delivering training and education to both clinical and administrative audiences
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Support, Marketing, and Product teams
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching peers, and setting standards or best practices adopted beyond your own work
* Experience planning work across multiple quarters and multiple stakeholder groups
* Willingness to travel nationally (up to ~50-75%), including on-site go-live support
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, and project tracking tools
* US-based, anchored in the West territory

#### **Nice-to-Haves**

* **Adoption-focused mindset.** You measure success by sustained usage, workflow integration, and customer outcomes rather than implementation completion alone.
* **Clinical workflow fluency.** You understand sleep lab workflows and how clinicians and their teams operate in practice, not just on paper.
* **Systems and operational thinking.** You see how implementation, training, adoption, workflow optimization, and customer success connect into a single operating system.
* **Independent judgment at scale.** Your recommendations are trusted without close oversight, and you are comfortable defining the approach when no playbook exists.
* **A multiplier effect.** You raise the performance of those around you through mentorship, reusable best practices, and standards that outlast any single implementation.
* **Comfort in a fast-paced environment.** You execute effectively in a high-growth startup where priorities evolve quickly.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, project tracking tools, and healthcare IT systems (EHR/EMR exposure a plus).
* Experience supporting SaMD or regulated medical device products.
* Prior experience at an early- or growth-stage healthcare company.
* Experience building a function's playbooks, templates, or training curricula from the ground up.

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $155,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Product Implementation Lead – US Remote, Eastern or Central Time Zone
jobs.description:
**Location: Remote, US – Eastern or Central Time Zone**

**Reports to: Chief Product Officer**

**Required availability: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday**

**Type: Full-time**

**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a US healthcare AI company automating the administrative work that slows down specialty care. Our agentic AI platform delivers touchless eligibility and benefits verification, autonomous prior authorization with EMR write-back, integrated care program enablement (RPM, CCM, PCM, TCM), and hospital readmission reduction, supported by a patient app and a provider app. We are live with 50+ paying customers across cardiology, pulmonology, and pain management and backed by an $8M seed round from 70+ physicians.

**The role**

You will be the person customers rely on to get issues resolved and the link between customers, Product, and Engineering. Reporting directly to the CPO, you will own customer inquiries and issues across our platform and patient and provider apps, keep customers informed through resolution, support customer onboarding, and translate customer workflows and needs into clear product requirements.

Resolving customer issues and communicating directly with customers will be a significant part of the role. You will assess the impact and urgency of issues, coordinate with the appropriate teams, and remain accountable for progress through resolution.

You will start each day working with our India, Vietnam, and Romania-based Engineering teams on priority issues, support our Central and East Coast customers through the business day, and close with a concise check-in with the CPO.

**What you’ll do**

* **Own customer inquiries and issues**. Act as the primary point of contact for product questions, issues, and escalations from practices and health systems, and see every one through to resolution. Understand the customer’s concern, gather the relevant information, assess its impact and urgency, involve Product, Engineering or other teams when needed, and remain accountable for keeping the issue moving and the customer informed.
* **Track every issue and communicate proactively**. Maintain a clear, current record of every open issue with its owner, status, customer impact, and next step. Update customers before they have to ask: when an issue is logged, when further investigation is required, when a fix or next step is scheduled, and when it is resolved. No customer should ever have to chase us for a status update.
* **Be the eligibility and benefits expert.** Explain eligibility and benefits results to practice staff with confidence: coverage status, plan type, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, network status, coordination of benefits, and whether a service requires prior authorization. When a result looks wrong, assess where the issue may be occurring and work with the appropriate internal or external team where further investigation is required.
* **Support the provider and patient apps.** Resolve customer-facing issues across the provider app used by clinicians and care teams and the patient app used by enrolled patients, including login and access, device data syncing, care plan and check-in workflows, notifications, and data that doesn’t match between the apps and the EMR. Gather and document the relevant information when Product or Engineering investigation is required.
* **Coordinate resolution of complex issues.** When a prior authorization doesn’t submit, a status doesn’t update, an EMR write-back fails, or patient data doesn’t reach the care team, gather the relevant customer, workflow and system information and work with Product, Engineering, payers, clearinghouses or other partners as appropriate to understand and resolve the issue.
* **Partner with Engineering.** Use the early-morning overlap to clearly document customer issues, provide the customer and workflow context needed for investigation, help assess customer and business impact and urgency, work with Engineering through resolution, and confirm fixes with customers.
* **Translate customer processes into product requirements**. Map each customer’s front-office, prior auth, eligibility, and care program workflows in detail, capture their specific requirements, and turn them into clear, testable product requirements and Jira tickets that Engineering can build from. Distinguish what is truly customer-specific configuration from what should become a product capability for all customers.
* **Identify product gaps**. Recognize patterns across customer issues, payer behavior, app usage, and workflows, and bring them to the CPO with supporting evidence and a recommended priority based on customer and operational impact.
* **Support customer onboarding.** Own assigned onboarding tasks for new customers, including configuration, EMR and payer workflow validation, app setup, and user training support. Validate that workflows work before go-live and catch early issues before customers do.
* **Report daily to the CPO.** Lead a concise end-of-day check-in with the CPO covering open issues, customer escalations, onboarding progress, product gaps, and priorities for the next morning’s Engineering overlap.
* **Build the playbook**. Maintain payer-specific troubleshooting guides, app support guides, known-issue documentation, and customer-facing help content.
* **Track payer and policy changes**. Flag changes to payer rules, prior auth requirements, benefit manager policies, and CMS guidance that affect how the product behaves.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 5+ years in healthcare RCM, practice operations, implementation, or product support, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing technical role at a health tech company.
* **Expert command of US eligibility and benefits verification.** You can walk a front-desk team or practice administrator through a benefits result in plain language across commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and managed Medicaid.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of prior authorization: submission requirements, clinical documentation, status tracking, and peer-to-peer and appeals processes.
* Working command of the full revenue cycle: eligibility, charge capture, coding (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS), claims, remittance, denials, and appeals.
* Hands-on working knowledge of at least two of these EMRs: athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Oracle Health (Cerner), and Epic.
* Hands-on experience with clearinghouses and multi-payer portals such as Availity, Waystar, and TriZetto.
* Hands-on experience with prior authorization and benefit management platforms such as Cohere Health, Evolent, and EviCore, and with payer portals including UnitedHealthcare, Humana, and Oscar.
* Experience supporting web or mobile applications, including troubleshooting user access, data sync, and device or integration issues.
* Experience investigating issues across systems, gathering the information required for resolution, and explaining issues clearly to engineers, practice staff, and patients.
* **Proven ability to translate customer processes into product requirements.** You can sit with a practice, understand exactly how their workflow runs, and write requirements that Engineering can build from without guessing.
* Strong judgment and prioritization skills. You can assess competing customer issues, understand their customer and business impact, determine urgency, and decide when and where escalation is required.
* **Ability to learn and adapt fast.** You get up to speed quickly on new payers, EMRs, workflows, and product areas, and you are comfortable with priorities that change as a fast-growing company evolves.
* Proficiency with Jira. You write tickets Engineering can act on without follow-up questions.
* Disciplined issue tracking and proactive customer communication. You keep every issue visible and current, and customers hear from you before they need to ask.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding or implementation projects.
* An acute sense of ownership. You remain accountable for customer communication and progress through resolution, even when another team owns the specialist technical investigation or fix.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including direct communication with US healthcare customers and asynchronous work with international teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with all four EMRs listed above.
* Familiarity with X12 transactions (270/271, 278, 837, 835), HL7, or FHIR.
* SQL or comfort querying data to support investigations.
* Experience in cardiology, pulmonology, or pain management practices.
* Exposure to RPM, CCM, or other CMS care management programs, including patient-facing remote monitoring apps and connected devices.
* Understanding of HIPAA requirements for patient-facing support.

**Working hours**

This is a full-time position requiring regular availability from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday.

The early start provides overlap with our Engineering teams in India, Vietnam and Romania so priority customer and product issues can be progressed before US customers begin their business day, followed by direct support for our East Coast customers through the business day.

The role requires availability throughout this coverage window, with reasonable flexibility to manage meal and personal breaks around customer and business requirements. Each day closes with a concise check-in with the CPO.

**What success looks like in 90 days**

* You are the go-to owner for customer inquiries and issues across the platform and both apps, with a defined issue-management and escalation process in place.
* You are effectively coordinating customer issues with Product, Engineering and other teams and ensuring they continue to progress through resolution.
* Issues identified during the early Engineering overlap are progressed with the appropriate teams before customers encounter them wherever possible.
* Every open issue is tracked with an owner, status, and next step, and customers receive proactive updates without having to follow up.
* You are independently running assigned onboarding tasks for new customers.
* The daily CPO check-in is a reliable, concise summary of issues, escalations, onboarding, and priorities.
* You have built payer-specific troubleshooting guides for our highest-volume payers and a support guide for the patient and provider apps.
* You have translated customer workflows into product requirements that Engineering has built from, with minimal clarification needed.
* You have brought forward a set of product gaps as clear, prioritized Jira tickets backed by customer evidence.

You are working independently across our main payers, EMRs, customer workflows and both apps, while effectively coordinating with Product and Engineering when specialist technical input is required.

**Why join**

* Work on a problem that directly affects whether patients get timely care.
* Report directly to the CPO and shape the product roadmap from day one.
* Work alongside physician investors and a founding team with multiple exits.

**Compensation:**  The position in salary range will take into account an assessment based on factors including the candidate's level of experience, education, skills, and location. A fully discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of base salary and a stock option plan also applies. Eligibility for benefits commences after completing a two month introductory period.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $95,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to work remotely Monday through Friday and remain available from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time? Answer Yes or No

Experience:

* healthcare RCM, practice ops, implementation or support: 5 years (Required)
* US healthcare eligibility/benefits & prior authorization: 2 years (Required)
* working with 2+ EMR's - athena, eCW, Cerner or Epic: 2 years (Required)
* a Customer-facing technical role in health technology: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director Clinical Systems Engineering - Remote
jobs.description:
**Crossroads Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since 2005, Crossroads has been at the forefront of treating patients with opioid use disorder. Crossroads is a family of professionals dedicated to providing the most accessible, highest quality, evidence-based medication assisted treatment (MAT) options to combat the growing opioid epidemic and helping people with opioid use disorder start their path to recovery. This comprehensive approach to treatment, the gold standard in care for opioid use disorder, has been shown to prevent more deaths from overdose and lead to long-term recovery. We are committed to bringing critical services to communities across the U.S. to improve access to treatment for over 26,500 patients. Our clinics are all outpatient and office-based, with clinics in Georgia, Kentucky, New Jersey, North and South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees and patients.

  

***Day in the Life of a Director, Clinical Systems Engineering***
=================================================================

***Key Responsibilities: Leadership and Delivery***

* Lead the EHR implementation and engineering team, including lead analysts and technical specialists, setting priorities, assigning work, and holding the team accountable for quality and timelines.
* Direct large-scale EHR migrations and consolidations across multiple states and care models, owning the overall delivery plan, sequencing, go-live readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Provide oversight of requirements, specifications, and build artifacts produced by the team, ensuring they are complete, traceable, and audit-ready before sign-off.
* Govern scope, change requests, and downstream impact decisions, and escalate trade-offs with clear cost, risk, and effort recommendations to senior leadership.
* Coach and develop team members, building career paths and technical depth across the team, and create the structure that lets senior analysts lead workstreams independently.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and technical counterpart to EHR vendors, trading partners, and internal IT, including SOW review and vendor performance management.

***Technical Oversight: Interfaces, Integration, Data, and Automation***

* Lead highly skilled technical teams across data, interface, and automation disciplines, with enough hands-on depth to challenge designs, assess vendor proposals, and unblock complex technical issues.
* Oversee the interface and data exchange portfolio, including HL7 v2 and FHIR messaging, laboratory and toxicology results, e-prescribing and EPCS, PDMP, pharmacy and dispensing systems, and reporting and analytics feeds.
* Own data migration strategy and quality for system transitions, including extraction, mapping, validation, and reconciliation of clinical, dosing, and billing data.
* Oversee eligibility, claims, and remittance transaction flows (270/271, 837, 835) in partnership with the revenue cycle team.
* Direct RPA and workflow automation initiatives that reduce manual work across EHRs and operational processes, including tool selection, governance, and maintenance standards.
* Establish monitoring standards for interface queues and error handling and lead root-cause analysis and remediation of major incidents.

***Experience We're Looking For***

* Proven record leading end-to-end EHR migrations or consolidations in a multi-site or multi-state healthcare organization.
* Experience leading large groups of technical teams, including data, interface, and automation specialists.
* Strong technical foundation in healthcare interoperability (HL7, FHIR, X12) and data migration, with the credibility to lead technical staff.
* Behavioral health, SUD, or OTP experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with 42 CFR Part 2.

***Education and/or Experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, information systems, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in clinical application configuration, systems analysis, or EHR implementation required.
* Minimum of 2 years of direct people leadership or formal project leadership experience required.
* Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end requirements gathering for clinical or enterprise software initiatives required.
* Hands-on configuration experience with at least one enterprise EHR or practice management platform required; behavioral health, substance use disorder, or OTP platform experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site EHR implementation, consolidation, or data migration required.
* Working knowledge of interfaces and integration (HL7, FHIR, API, SFTP) required. Demonstrated hands-on SQL experience is required and will be assessed during the interview process.
* Knowledge of OTP and OBOT operations, including methadone and buprenorphine dispensing workflows, take-home regulations, and 42 CFR Part 2, strongly preferred.
* Experience with a healthcare clearinghouse and familiarity with revenue cycle workflows preferred.
* Professional certification such as CPHIMS, CAHIMS, PMP, Certified Scrum Product Owner, Six Sigma, or vendor-specific application certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to clinic sites as required to support implementations, go-lives, and workflow assessments.
* Experience building reports, extracts, or dashboards used by operational or executive leadership required; experience owning data validation for a system conversion strongly preferred.
* Healthcare experience is required, with behavioral health or MAT experience highly preferred.

***Benefits Package***
======================

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* PTO
* Variety of 401K options including a match program with no vesture period
* Annual Continuing Education Allowance (in related field)
* Life Insurance
* Short/Long Term Disability
* Paid maternity/paternity leave
* Mental Health Day
* *Calm* subscription for all employees

jobs.title: System Implementation Project Lead
jobs.description:
**Introduction**

Retina Consultants of America is identifying and evaluating candidates for the position of **System Implementation Project Lead**. This position will report to the Director of System Operations. The System Implementation Project Lead role is a highly visible and challenging role that will help execute the vision of the company’s long-term and short-term strategy and become an integral member of a dynamic and experienced operational team.

**Our Company**

Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is bringing together national leaders in surgical and clinical care. This network comprises preeminent retina research specialists with the common goal of eradicating blindness caused by macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and other retina diseases.

With over 2.3M annual patient visits, more than 315 physicians, and more than 295 locations, Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is the largest retina care provider in the nation.

**Our Mission**

Through RCA’s physician-centered practice management model, physicians continue to drive clinical care and practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise, resources and sharing best practices.

RCA seeks to expand our mission by partnering with leading retina specialists who are passionate about delivering excellent patient care and participating in innovative research.

RCA has created a business model that enables retina specialists to retain autonomy and ownership, augmented by sharing best practices facilitated through the Medical Leadership Board and executive management support. Practices within the network will continue to drive all clinical decisions and remain highly involved in strategic operations.

**Our Core Values**

· Relentlessly Commit to our Patients, to the Practices We Serve and to Our Mission

· Embrace the Legacies of Our Partner Practices

· Strive for Continuous Improvement Through Education and Research

· Exude Compassion in All We Do

**Position Overview**

The System Implementation Project Lead is responsible for managing and overseeing implementations of new EHR/PM systems and ancillary products simultaneously across multiple practices within the platform. They will collaborate with key stakeholders, practice RCM and Clinical leaders, and other departments within the company to ensure that all key project milestones and timelines are achieved. The System Implementation Project Lead role requires comprehensive knowledge of physician revenue cycle management and clinical workflows to successfully lead implementations, align operational and clinical processes, and drive performance improvement. The ideal candidate demonstrates attention to detail, accountability, accuracy, sound business judgment, and the ability to balance organizational goals with the needs of providers, staff, and patients.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead implementation projects for clinical and operational systems, including EHR, Practice Management, patient engagement, and other healthcare technology platforms.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables.

jobs.description:
Digital Strategy is seeking a **Change Management & Training Specialist** to support the rollout and adoption of new systems, system enhancements, data products, reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities for a federal client.

This is a hands-on role combining **change management, instructional design, training delivery, communications, and user adoption support**. The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users across approximately 20 client offices, including several offices that have recently joined the organization and may have different processes, systems, and adoption needs.

The client’s data and analytics environment includes **Power BI and Databricks**, so the role will also support adoption of dashboards, reports, data products, and self-service analytics capabilities delivered through these platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute change-management and user-adoption plans for new systems, enhancements, data products, and process changes.
* Assess stakeholder impacts, readiness, training needs, and adoption risks across different offices and user groups.
* Develop practical training materials, including job aids, user guides, quick-reference guides, presentations, demonstrations, and FAQs.
* Deliver virtual instructor-led training, system demonstrations, workshops, office hours, and other user-support sessions.
* Support rollout and adoption of **Power BI reports and dashboards, Databricks-enabled data products, and self-service analytics capabilities**.
* Tailor training and change approaches based on user roles, business processes, technical proficiency, and office-specific needs.
* Develop communications that clearly explain what is changing, why it matters, and what users need to do differently.
* Work with product owners and technical teams to incorporate user feedback into future releases and enhancements.
* Support rollout activities and help identify and address barriers to adoption.
* Use modern tools, including AI-assisted content-development tools where appropriate, to efficiently create polished training and communications materials.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in instructional design, organizational development, communications, education, business, information systems, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in change management, instructional design, training, user adoption, organizational transformation, or a combination of these areas.
* Demonstrated experience supporting technology or system implementations.
* Hands-on experience developing training materials and delivering virtual or instructor-led training.
* Strong facilitation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
* Ability to translate technical concepts and system changes into clear, practical guidance for business users.
* Ability to independently develop polished, client-ready deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Federal government consulting experience.
* Experience supporting enterprise-wide system or process changes across multiple offices or business units.
* Experience supporting adoption of **Power BI, Databricks, dashboards, reporting platforms, data products, or self-service analytics**.
* Familiarity with Prosci/ADKAR or other change-management methodologies.
* Experience working in Agile or product-development environments.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools to develop training, communications, or learning content.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on level—someone who can develop a change plan, create the training materials, deliver the training, work directly with users, and help drive adoption through rollout and beyond.

Join us to be part of a forward-thinking organization committed to empowering clients through innovative solutions! Your expertise will help shape transformative change initiatives that make a real impact across organizations while enjoying the flexibility of remote work.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* U.S. Citizenship

Experience:

* creating training for system rollouts: 5 years (Required)
* delivering live or virtual training: 5 years (Required)
* supporting system or data-product adoption: 5 years (Required)
* OCM + instructional design + training: 5 years (Required)
* Federal consulting : 4 years (Preferred)
* change management, training, or adoption: 5 years (Required)
* Emerging Tech Adoption (Power BI, Databricks, AI Features): 2 years (Preferred)
